faq.title: The short answers
faq.lead: If something is missing here, write to us and we will answer.

start.q: How long does it take to get going?
start.a: Signing up takes a minute, then you add products and start selling. No server to set up, nothing to install, no engineer to call — TIM runs in the browser.

training.a: The checkout screen works by tapping a size, which drops it into the receipt. One shift is usually enough for someone to work confidently.

data.q: Where is my data kept and who can see it?
data.a: Each shop is kept separate: a staff member sees only their own shop, and only what their role allows. The owner sees everything.

offline.q: What happens if the internet drops?
offline.a: Honestly: right now you need a connection. An offline checkout mode is planned, and we would rather not promise it as finished.

devices.a: Computer, tablet and phone. Checkout is usually used from a tablet at the counter, reports from a computer.

switch.q: Everything of mine is in a notebook and a spreadsheet. How do I move over?
switch.a: Start with the products you sell every day and add the rest as you go. There is no need to move everything at once.
